snippet.title: Alien Hominid HD - Launch Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011255

Alien Hominid is BACK on PlayStation®! With your mighty blaster and a group of mysterious kids by your side, destroy the agency and reclaim your spaceship! Fight your way to Area 51 and beyond to rack up those trophies, or take a break from the chaos with all of the original mini games!

Experience the re-release of the original Alien Hominid on PlayStation® today from The Behemoth, creators of co-op adventures like Castle Crashers and BattleBlock Theater!

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games
